Maya (marketing): Heads-up: launch day plan — need changelog one-liner, docs anchor, RSVP link, benchmark stat, and lead routing. Canary window?
Diego (eng): Canary scheduled Thu 08:00 PT for 3h. Ramp 10% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto rollback if error >3% or p95 > SLO.
Maya (marketing): Can we get a concise changelog blurb? 1 line for the hero.
Diego (eng): "Adaptive KV caching yields ~14% p95 improvement on long-context workloads."
Priya (docs): Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.3. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.3#changelog
Maya (marketing): Tiny code sample for blog?
Priya (docs): Paste: ```
client.configure({cache:'adaptive', batch: true})
```
Omar (growth): Landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/events/v2-3-3 (will add UTM params). Will publish at 09:00 PT.
Tess (salesops): Routing rules: event RSVPs -> SFDC campaign v2_3_3; employee_count>300 -> AE queue "Enterprise-Intl"; others -> inbound SDR. I'll push mappings after landing page is live.
ci-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary 1717020000, full roll 1717023600. Monitor: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/ccc999
Diego (eng): Please avoid heavy press/social spikes first 20m — cache warmup can inflate p95.
Maya (marketing): We'll stagger sends: email wave 1 at +30m, social after 1h. I'll post draft in #marketing-drafts in ~2h.
Tess (salesops): Ran RSVP test with employee_count=800 — AE queue assignment OK and SFDC tag applied.
Maya (marketing): Thanks team — assembling final announce. :thumbsup:
